item.description: From Serbia to Bangladesh and India to France, young people are pushing back against authoritarianism and reshaping political landscapes In Brazil, they rallied online by the millions, sharing videos and spreading memes. item.description: León XIV llega este viernes a Uruguay, el país menos católico de Iberoamérica, donde la laicidad es parte integrante de la identidad nacional. Allí oficialmente el 25 de diciembre no es Navidad, sino el Día de la Familia, y la Semana Santa es la Semana de Turismo. Estará hasta el domingo y lo guiará un cardenal de 67 años que ha conseguido que la Iglesia sea una de las voces más autorizadas de esta sociedad. Se trata de Daniel Sturla, arzobispo de Montevideo, una de las figuras que más han influido en la renovación de la Iglesia católica uruguaya, con la idea de que ésta no debía quedarse… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.title: Most Europeans want action to tackle climate crisis but not at any cost, poll shows
item.description: YouGov survey finds support for tree planting and emissions taxes but opposition to air travel and fuel levies Europe live – latest updates Europeans believe human-made climate change is real, a survey has shown, with most feeling action must be taken soon – as long as they do not have to sacrifice too much to achieve it. The YouGov poll of six European countries showed between 69% (Germany) and 80% (France) of respondents believed the climate was changing, with few (1%-4%) denying it and 14-20% believing it was changing, but not as a result of human activity.
